note: All six acceptance criteria verified by tests on real migrated repos (tests/test_worktree_git_ops.py, 79; tests/test_worktree_docs.py, 14). The ADR-001 zero-code-change hypothesis was false: non-hub commit crashed on the ignored path, hub commit was a silent no-op, push sent main. Fixed by running every PM git op inside the store (store_git_state / push_branch in worktree.py), adding pm_store to git_status_all and on_branch to commit results, and pushing the store branch after the hub push. worktree.py at 100% coverage. Full unit suite: 5040 passed; the one failure (migrate-archived docstring test) is a Click 8.5 sentinel-default change unrelated to this story.
